name: Senshu Ikeda Holdings, Inc.
summary: Senshu Ikeda Holdings, Inc. provides banking products and services to small and medium-sized enterprises, and individuals in Japan. The company operates through the Banking Business and Leasing Business segments. It offers various deposit products, including current, ordinary, savings, notice, and other deposits; and business, public and personal, and housing loans. The company also provides securities, leasing, credit guarantee, domestic and foreign exchange, trust, corporate bond trusteeship and registration, and credit card services.
